title: Senate PR bureau apologizes for 'fire' transition effect during Cayetano’s prayer
summary: In a statement on Thursday, November 19, Senate PRIB said that the fire effect was due to an “unexpected technical issue during the broadcast,” which they “deeply regret.”

blocks.text: Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano during a prayer before the start of the impeachment of Vice President Sara Duterte on Nov. 19, 2026.

MANILA, Philippines — The Senate Public Relations and Information Bureau apologized for the “fire” transition effect during Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano’s prayer at the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte.
In a statement on Thursday, November 19, Senate PRIB said that the fire effect was due to an “unexpected technical issue during the broadcast,” which they “deeply regret.”

“The PRIB is currently upgrading its equipment and undergoing retraining and upskilling of its technical staff in a bid to strengthen the quality of broadcast media coverage for the Filipino people,” the Senate PRIB said.
“We appreciate the public's understanding and assure our continued commitment to responsible, transparent, and credible broadcast media coverage of all Senate's proceedings,” it added.
The incident occurred during Cayetano’s prayer, after which the defense panel appeared on the screen.
The defense panel continued presenting its witnesses for Article II of the Articles of Impeachment on Thursday.
Article II tackles Duterte’s alleged unexplained wealth and irregularities in her Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth.
